blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Alas Pilipinas Men pushed Southeast Asian rival Indonesia to its limits but couldn’t secure its first Asian Games classification win, falling 23-25, 26-24, 22-25, 21-25 on Thursday at Park Arena Komaki. Alas stayed within striking distance in each set, but former SEA Games champion held its nerve, with Boy Arnez Arabi leading the way with 20 points. Fauzan Nibras chipped in 17 kills on 13 kills, three blocks, and an ace for Indonesia, which faces Vietnam on Friday. Alas, which had a winless Pool D campaign, […]...
